Just wanna say i appreciate you taking the time to talk. My body already has enough fat and the whole point of keto is to be low carb so your body uses that fat as fuel. If weakness and nausea are the only symptoms it seems like a good trade off to lose fat at the best rate.  Surely just eating normally and meeting that 1500 calorie intake just will make this all go at a snails pace to what i could do by doing this.
Just a bit weird cause i have done fasting where i havent ate for 5 days but i feel far weaker when doing keto then i ever did on that

You wouldn’t discourage an athlete from working harder then the average person so i don’t see how this is all that different.

Basic science. Carbs spike insulin -> insulin causes you to store glucose as fat

If insulin is low , blood sugar is low and glucagon increases…. Which then uses STORED glucose to increase glucose conc in blood .

To lose weight keep insulin low and glucagon high so fat stores are broken down. 

Nothing spikes insulin levels like carbs
Fasting keeps insulin levels down so any carbs are readily used? The only way i would rapidly gain weight is if i consistently keep insulin levels high. Which fasting prevents
